full_page.content:
Page 30
Feb. Mrs. Emma Ewald - 44 - Lutheran - nerves
Anna Haener - 52 - badly burned two weeks ago, 3rd degree burn Pray for her
Veronia Maher- Margaret 19 mo. - pneumonia .....
Amelia Farmer - 61 - inward cancer (of utrice) was refused absol. some 18 yrs. ago. Then turned to "so called" Christian Science" About Christmas last found to a hopeless case of Cancer; was given Three months to live ... seeing her Enrollment certificate ... now astonishing the Drs. in Battle Creek Hospt'1
Gloria Molinaro - 23 - having fits for over a yr ... made 9 Wednes- days ... Thank God .. O.K.
Feb. 22 Harold Mellen - 34 - in Ypsilanti Hosp. nerve trouble ... worry about his three little children - oldest 6.
Eleanor Czizek - 42 - has had fits for 30 yrs. They seem to be decidedly going and she ask prayers. . Page 31
Feb. 25 Aloysius Rotter - 80 - away from holy sacraments & church 54 yrs. Enrolled To-day
Salvatore Pianello - 33 - Stomach cancer feated - in bed now close to 8 months.
Hugh A. McKinnan - 69 - dying of heart trouble three weeks ago. Still living. .... Drs. Astonished
26 Agnes McCormick of Kingston Ont. eye infection -
Dan. Linskey - away from home 20 yrs. His Rev. Br. died a week ago .... His sister a nun asks for prayers ...
27 Johan Cannizzaro - 51 - fears something like possession - cannot go to confession, has not been 30 yrs. was studying for priest- hood. Then the young priest who was to put him through his studies died and he had to quit ..... Was enrolled in Ser. Mass Assocn. Feb. 18 - felt fine for a week .... always prays for Rev. friend but something holds him back from Confession.
Baby Francis Fella - 19 mo. - pneumonia - 2 mastoid operation.
